programs.title: Good Bones
programs.desc: Mina and Karen return to Old Southside to renovate the right side of their duplex townhome using a Greenwich Village design; Karen shares a major announcement about her position in the company.

programs.title: The Nate And Jeremiah Home Project
programs.desc: A couple buy their first home with dreams of filling it with a family. Nate and Jeremiah give it a modern makeover with a family-friendly vibe throughout.

programs.title: Getaway
programs.desc: This week on Getaway we are in Greece visiting some of the most historic sites of all time including the ancient neighbourhoods of Athens, the sacred precinct of Delphi plus the remains of Olympia.

programs.title: Postcards
programs.desc: Sammy J shows us the art and culture in Mildura. Shane explores a range of cuisines on offer in St Kilda. Madeline is in QLD at a paddock to plate pub. And Brodie checks out an incredible eco-friendly accommodation in the Yarra Valley.

programs.title: Renovation 911
programs.desc: Lindsey and Kirsten race to rescue a teacher's porch and living room after sustaining major fire damage, and they also look to remodel her kitchen. Then, the sisters respond to long-time clients after nineteen of their radiators burst during a cold snap.

programs.title: Building Alaska
programs.desc: Chappie Cook's team runs into bears and sinking boats while hauling scaffolding materials; Jeff Erickson carefully begins to construct his slippery roof; Chris Sewell works tirelessly to install all the timber walls of his cabin.
